title: State
description: One ISO 3166-2 subdivision. States nest via parent_id, so a country's subdivisions form a forest, not a flat list (Decision 3).

state_code.description: Upstream `iso2` on the state record: the subdivision part only, e.g. ABE.

iso3166_2.description: Full ISO 3166-2 code, e.g. GB-ABE. Preferred join key.

level.description: Upstream's semantic administrative level. ADVISORY ONLY -- it does not track tree depth. Use `depth`.

parent_id.description: Another state's id. Resolves and is acyclic (validation checks 1 and 5).

depth.description: Computed from the parent chain. Authoritative tree position.

stable_key.description: Decision 2, tiered: iso3166_2, then state_code, then normalized name.
